name: Google Fonts
why: Google font CDN requests from Iran fail or time out, so pages render with fallback fonts and block on the stylesheet.

alternatives.name: Self-hosted Vazirmatn
alternatives.migration_note: Download the woff2 files into assets/fonts and declare them with @font-face; remove the Google <link>/@import.

alternatives.name: @fontsource/vazirmatn
alternatives.migration_note: npm install @fontsource/vazirmatn and import it in your entry file; fonts are bundled with your build.

name: Google reCAPTCHA
why: The reCAPTCHA script does not load reliably for Iranian users, so forms protected by it cannot be submitted.

alternatives.name: svg-captcha (Node, self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Generate the challenge on your server and verify the answer in the session.

alternatives.name: Gregwar/Captcha (PHP, self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: composer require gregwar/captcha; store the phrase in the session and compare on submit.

name: Cloudflare Turnstile
why: Availability from Iranian networks varies; a failed challenge locks users out of the form.

alternatives.name: svg-captcha (Node, self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Serve and verify the captcha from your own server.

name: Google Maps
why: Google Maps Platform does not serve API keys or tiles to Iran.

alternatives.name: Neshan Maps
alternatives.migration_note: Use the Neshan web SDK (Leaflet/OpenLayers based) with a Neshan API key; geocoding and routing APIs are available.

alternatives.name: Map.ir
alternatives.migration_note: Map.ir offers tiles, search and reverse geocoding with an Iranian account.

alternatives.name: Leaflet + OpenStreetMap
alternatives.migration_note: Use Leaflet with an OSM tile server; self-host tiles for production traffic.

name: Mapbox
why: Mapbox accounts and tokens are not available to Iranian users.

alternatives.name: Neshan Maps
alternatives.migration_note: Swap the map component for the Neshan SDK.

alternatives.name: MapLibre GL + self-hosted tiles
alternatives.migration_note: MapLibre is an open-source fork of mapbox-gl with a near-identical API.

name: Firebase
why: Firebase (Google Cloud) blocks Iranian IPs and accounts; auth, database and storage calls fail.

alternatives.name: Supabase (self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Run Supabase with Docker on an Iranian server; auth, Postgres and storage replace Firebase Auth/Firestore/Storage.

alternatives.name: Appwrite (self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Self-host Appwrite; its SDK covers auth, database, storage and functions.

alternatives.name: PocketBase
alternatives.migration_note: Single binary backend with auth, realtime DB and file storage; good for small apps.

name: Google Cloud APIs
why: Google Cloud does not serve Iran; requests and account creation are refused.

alternatives.name: ArvanCloud Object Storage
alternatives.migration_note: S3-compatible: use an S3 client with the ArvanCloud endpoint.

alternatives.name: MinIO (self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Run MinIO on your own server and use any S3 client.

name: Google Analytics / Tag Manager
why: GA scripts are blocked for Iranian visitors, so analytics data is missing and the script can delay page load.

alternatives.name: Umami (self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Self-host Umami and replace the gtag snippet with the Umami script tag.

alternatives.name: Matomo (self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Self-host Matomo (PHP + MySQL); it can import GA history.

name: Sign in with Google
why: Google OAuth is inconsistent from Iran and creating the OAuth client needs a Google Cloud project.

alternatives.name: Phone OTP via an Iranian SMS provider
alternatives.migration_note: Send a one-time code to the user's mobile number; validate the number format with @persian-tools/persian-tools.

alternatives.name: Keycloak (self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Self-hosted OpenID Connect provider if you need SSO.

name: YouTube embeds
why: YouTube is filtered in Iran; embedded players show an empty frame.

alternatives.name: Aparat embed
alternatives.migration_note: Upload the video to Aparat and use its embed iframe.

alternatives.name: Self-hosted HLS video
alternatives.migration_note: Host the video on an Iranian VOD/CDN service or your own server and play it with a <video> tag or hls.js.

name: Facebook / Instagram / X (Twitter) widgets
why: These platforms are filtered in Iran; widgets and pixels fail and can stall page load.

alternatives.name: Static links and screenshots
alternatives.migration_note: Replace the embed with a plain link and a local image of the post.

alternatives.name: Umami (self-hosted) instead of tracking pixels
alternatives.migration_note: Track conversions with self-hosted analytics events.

name: Gravatar
why: Gravatar images load inconsistently from Iran, leaving broken avatars.

alternatives.name: DiceBear (generated locally)
alternatives.migration_note: Generate avatars server-side or at build time with @dicebear/core; no external request.

alternatives.name: Initials avatar
alternatives.migration_note: Render the user's initials in an inline SVG or styled <span>.

name: OpenAI API
why: OpenAI does not support Iran; requests and account signup are refused.

alternatives.name: Ollama (self-hosted open-weight models)
alternatives.migration_note: Ollama exposes an OpenAI-compatible API; point the SDK baseURL at your server.

alternatives.name: vLLM (self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: OpenAI-compatible server for GPU hosts; keep the SDK and change baseURL.

name: Anthropic API
why: Iran is not a supported region for the Anthropic API.

alternatives.name: Ollama (self-hosted open-weight models)
alternatives.migration_note: Run an open-weight model locally and call it over its HTTP API.

name: Google Gemini API
why: The Gemini API is not available in Iran.

alternatives.name: Ollama (self-hosted open-weight models)
alternatives.migration_note: Run an open-weight model locally and call it over its HTTP API.

name: Docker Hub image pulls
why: Docker Hub refuses pulls from Iranian IPs; images without a registry prefix default to Docker Hub.

alternatives.name: ArvanCloud Docker mirror
alternatives.migration_note: Prefix images with the mirror host (e.g. docker.arvancloud.ir/library/node:20) or set it as a registry-mirror in daemon.json.

alternatives.name: Harbor (self-hosted registry)
alternatives.migration_note: Run your own registry and push the base images you need to it.

name: npm public registry
why: registry.npmjs.org is slow or intermittently unreachable from Iran, which breaks installs and CI.

alternatives.name: Liara package mirror
alternatives.migration_note: Set registry=<mirror URL> in .npmrc; check Liara docs for the current npm mirror address.

alternatives.name: Verdaccio (self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Run a caching npm proxy inside your network and point .npmrc at it.

name: Packagist (Composer)
why: Composer installs from Packagist/GitHub dist URLs are slow or fail from Iran.

alternatives.name: Satis (self-hosted Composer repo)
alternatives.migration_note: Mirror the packages you need and add your Satis URL to composer.json repositories.

name: Public JS CDNs (jsDelivr, unpkg, cdnjs, Google Hosted Libraries)
why: These CDNs are filtered or throttled at times in Iran; a failed script can break the whole page.

alternatives.name: Bundle or self-host the library
alternatives.migration_note: Install the package and ship it from your own server or bundle.

alternatives.name: ArvanCloud CDN
alternatives.migration_note: Put your own static files behind an Iranian CDN.

name: Stripe
why: Stripe does not onboard Iranian businesses and Iranian bank cards are not accepted.

alternatives.name: Zarinpal
alternatives.migration_note: Request -> redirect -> verify flow; amounts are in Rial or Toman depending on API version, check the docs.

alternatives.name: Zibal
alternatives.migration_note: Similar request/verify gateway flow with a merchant code.

alternatives.name: IDPay
alternatives.migration_note: REST gateway with sandbox mode for testing.

name: PayPal
why: PayPal does not operate in Iran.

alternatives.name: Zarinpal
alternatives.migration_note: Replace the PayPal button with a server-side Zarinpal request and verify callback.

alternatives.name: Zibal
alternatives.migration_note: Server-side request/verify gateway.

name: Vercel
why: Vercel accounts are not available to Iranian users and deployments can be suspended.

alternatives.name: Liara
alternatives.migration_note: Iranian PaaS with Next.js/Node support; deploy with the liara CLI.

alternatives.name: Hamravesh (Darkube)
alternatives.migration_note: Container-based PaaS; deploy a Dockerfile.

name: Netlify
why: Netlify accounts are not available to Iranian users.

alternatives.name: Liara static hosting
alternatives.migration_note: Deploy the static build folder with the liara CLI.

alternatives.name: ArvanCloud
alternatives.migration_note: Object storage + CDN for static sites.

name: Amazon Web Services
why: AWS does not allow accounts from Iran. Note: the S3 SDK itself is fine against S3-compatible Iranian storage.

alternatives.name: ArvanCloud Object Storage
alternatives.migration_note: Keep @aws-sdk/client-s3 (or aws-sdk-php) and set endpoint to the ArvanCloud S3 endpoint.

alternatives.name: Liara Object Storage
alternatives.migration_note: S3-compatible; change endpoint and credentials only.

alternatives.name: MinIO (self-hosted)
alternatives.migration_note: Self-hosted S3-compatible storage.

name: Heroku
why: Heroku (Salesforce) does not allow accounts from Iran.

alternatives.name: Liara
alternatives.migration_note: Supports Procfile-style Node/PHP/Python apps.

name: Sentry (SaaS)
why: sentry.io does not serve Iranian accounts; the SDK can still talk to a self-hosted server.

alternatives.name: GlitchTip (self-hosted, Sentry-compatible)
alternatives.migration_note: Keep the Sentry SDK and change the DSN to your GlitchTip server.

alternatives.name: Self-hosted Sentry
alternatives.migration_note: Run Sentry with Docker Compose; keep the SDK, change the DSN.

name: Twilio
why: Twilio does not allow Iranian accounts and does not deliver reliably to Iranian numbers.

alternatives.name: Kavenegar
alternatives.migration_note: REST SMS/OTP API with Node and PHP SDKs.

alternatives.name: SMS.ir
alternatives.migration_note: REST SMS API with OTP templates.

name: SendGrid / Mailchimp
why: These providers close accounts linked to Iran.

alternatives.name: Postal (self-hosted mail server)
alternatives.migration_note: Self-hosted SMTP/HTTP mail delivery; configure SPF/DKIM for your domain.

alternatives.name: Your host's SMTP
alternatives.migration_note: Send via SMTP with nodemailer (Node) or PHPMailer (PHP).
